description: The plot illustrates the training loss curves for several variants of the SepLLM model and a baseline (StrmLLM), as a function of the number of iterations, ranging from 0 to 140,000 on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” spans from 2.4 to 3.4, also on a linear scale, with major gridlines every 0.1 unit. Five distinct lines are shown: a purple line for StrmLLM (n=64), which starts near 3.35 and decreases steadily to approximately 2.52; an orange line for SepLLM (n=64), beginning around 3.3 and declining to about 2.51; a green line for SepLLM (n=64, H), starting near 3.28 and ending at roughly 2.50; a red line for SepLLM (n=64, H/T), which begins around 3.25 and converges to approximately 2.49; and a blue line for SepLLM (n=128), starting at 3.35 and decreasing to about 2.61. All lines exhibit a steep initial drop in loss within the first 20,000 iterations, followed by a slower, more gradual decline toward convergence. The legend is positioned in the upper right corner, with each line labeled by model variant and configuration.
